title: The Immersive Hero
text: “A masked hero hides their true face, keeps a low profile, but at the core it’s all about a sense of justice, so they value their methods carefully. If hostages get taken, rescuing them comes first, and they demand legitimacy in their actions. Just think of it as a hero who commits fully to playing some fictional someone else.”
“Nano, Gaelion understands. That’s definitely been the type for Fleon and Bow Hero so far, nano.”
An immersive hero… True, Fleon-chan does insert her own name into “Magical Fleon,” but I do think she simply likes the transformation costumes, indeed.

“Now, a dark hero holds beliefs that diverge from conventional good, and doesn’t pick their methods. There’s degrees to it, but even if a hostage is taken, if there’s a chance to take down someone who must be defeated, they won’t hesitate to strike even if the hostage goes down with them. People call it ‘falling to darkness,’ and honestly there’s no mask involved. That’s why Itsuki carries on so calmly as riska and has no interest in going back to human form.”
“In a way, nano, that makes Bow Hero rare among all the loops so far, nano.”

“Probably so. Well, from Itsuki’s perspective, maybe he looks at Fleon-chan’s sense of justice—or Theo’s, or Rishia-san’s—with a kind of warm nostalgia, like it’s the justice he himself used to champion long ago.”
Father remarked that it sounded like a character type he recognized. Apparently there’s someone like that in some anime Father knows of, indeed.
“So is it like a Wild Naofumi type, nano?”
“Why does it always circle back to me?”
“Well, honestly, even Wild Naofumi wouldn’t change all that much, nano. Mouth’s foul, sure, but he still looked after everyone, nano.”
“I mean, I’m Shield Hero, so ‘not picking your methods’ is a pretty tall order for me.”

At that moment, a certain image flashed through my mind—Father unleashing a curse skill. …Indeed, Father was never the type to harm a hostage, but he never hesitated to harm himself. Still… I suspect that even this gentle Father of mine wouldn’t budge on that point either.
“So Kuro being Black Thunder and liking dark heroes and shadows, nano, Gaelion gets that. But he’s a total wimp, nano. The moment he was looked at by the true abyss, he ran away, nano.”
“The true abyss… wait, are you saying you’ve actually met it, Gaelion-chan…”
“Seriously did, nano.”
Rival was surely talking about Ark. That man is nothing of the sort, I say. He merely fights with terrifying ferocity while remaining an utterly gentle soul, indeed.
“He was a gentle man indeed. He once told me that nights exist for the sake of peaceful sleep, roughly speaking.”
“Heh… somehow that sounds like there’s more depth to him than meets the eye.”

“In any case, the fact that Fleon-chan and Itsuki can’t get along means, in short, that Fleon-chan has no one to play with. If Ren is going to be her playmate, we need to properly set the stage, I say.”
“Motoyasu-kun, you already ran wild with the usaunny incident, so you need to hold back this time.”
Father scolded me. Curses… even if it’s for Fleon-chan’s sake, not being able to set Ren loose is truly regrettable, I say.
“Rafumi-chan might be willing to play along, but… I wonder how that’d go.”
“Rafumi won’t be Fleon’s playmate, nano, but she’ll definitely jump on board for mischief, nano.”
“That might be the best compromise we get… though Rafumi-chan’s got a mean streak too. Guess we’ll just keep an eye on things for now.”

And so, a week passed since Filo-tan and the others escaped the castle. During that time, we managed to link up with Queen. When we intercepted the Queen’s faction forces moving in from the southwest of Melromarc to negotiate terms, Queen greeted us thus. We arrived at the base her forces had built, and now we were talking things over in the operations headquarters.
“To the Four Cardinal Heroes, it is an honor to finally meet you all… I offer my deepest apologies here for the tremendous trouble our nation’s troubles have caused you.”

Father was chosen to act as our representative, indeed. Incidentally, Itsuki remained as riska, indeed, and was riding on Father’s shoulder. I wanted to ride there too, but Father ordered me to stay in human form, so human form it was, indeed. Queen’s gaze lingered on Itsuki for quite some time. Afterward she turned to look at Ren, whose reputation within the kingdom was high. Ren, apparently sensing trouble, had retreated a few steps behind Father as if using him as a shield. His face plainly read, “I want no part of whatever’s coming.” Incidentally, Ren has lately been getting pestered by Kuro-chan. Apparently now that Luna-chan stopped approaching him, Ren grumbled, “So it’s this guy’s turn next!”

“Er… I believe some of this has already been explained to you, but I’m Naofumi Iwatani, Shield Hero. This is Motoyasu Kitamura, Spear Hero, and this is Ren Amaki, Sword Hero… and this little one here, after going through quite an ordeal, ended up transformed into a fairy-like riska form thanks to Motoyasu-kun’s magic—this is Itsuki Kawasumi, Bow Hero.”
“Pleased to meet you, I say!”
“…Hmph.”
“Pleasure to meet you.”
“I am Mirellia Q Melromarc, Queen of Melromarc. I apologize for the delay in coming to your aid.”
“You can say that again. What an absurd country this is. Wouldn’t the world be better off if it were just destroyed?”
Itsuki seized the opportunity to land a jab.

“I have no words to offer in my defense. But it is also true that if we can overcome this crisis, we may finally purge our nation of its deep-rooted corruption… I know we have caused you tremendous trouble, but I beg your cooperation.”
Queen, looking somewhat on edge, delivered her formal explanation.
“Yeah. Honestly, when it comes to Melromarc’s corruption, Itsuki and I have both suffered plenty because of it. I want this settled once and for all.”
Father, too, had his own reasons to feel motivated for this undertaking, indeed.
“The thing is… I was quite startled to hear that the heroes, who should have been cornered and hiding within the country, were calmly operating outside its borders…”
“Well, I’d just say, don’t underestimate the heroes too much.”
“And also—”
“Your Majesty!”
Just as Queen was about to say something, Éclair, whom we’d brought along, stepped forward, knelt, and saluted as she cut into the conversation.

“Knight Eclair, is it… I have heard the reports. That you were taken under the Shield Hero’s protection. I have no intention of punishing you for that matter. I intend to hear you out as much as I am able.”
There is also the matter of your late father, whom I trusted deeply, Queen continued.
“Please continue to lend your strength to the heroes. Once this incident is resolved, I promise the restoration of the Seaetto family’s standing.”
“I am deeply grateful for Her Majesty’s magnanimous mercy.”
“Now then. As for the whereabouts of our citizens, let alone our nobles—”
“Can we skip the roundabout talk and get to the point?”
Itsuki, clearly irritated, cut in and demanded she get on with it. Whether intentional or not, it interrupted whatever Queen had been about to ask.

“…My apologies. Currently, the Three Heroes Church has run amok and seized the castle in Melromarc. We have also confirmed that Aultcray, Melty, and others fled and are now hiding within the country, continuing their activities in secret.”

“For now, I think we need to link up with the King, but if I’m the one to do it, things could easily get complicated, and I’ve judged that provoking the current King might not be wise for the other heroes either. Your Majesty… could I ask for your cooperation?”
“That is precisely what we intended to ask of you.”
Queen agreed with Father’s proposal, evidently sharing the same objective.

“I am deeply sorry that, in the current climate, Melromarc burns with hatred toward Iwatani-sama, yet I am grateful for your cooperation. We would ask that Iwatani-sama take shelter while we attempt to make contact with Aultcray.”
“As for that… I intend to help without being noticed too much. It doesn’t sit right with me as a hero to withdraw from the front lines.”
“But…”
“Don’t worry, I won’t provoke the citizens.”
Father added that he’d try to keep as low a profile as possible.
